method.control: Implementation is limited to one dependency-free in-memory compatibility-class enum, focused tests, and morize-core re-exports. No serialization, parsing, numeric representation, version negotiation, deprecation window, error taxonomy, persistence, configuration, or third-party dependency is authorized.
method.review_separation: An independent semantic reviewer must review the exact implementation head, closed-vocabulary fidelity, absence of invented wire semantics, scope containment, and required evidence separately from the implementing agent before acceptance.
method.rollback: Revert the compatibility-class implementation commits; no persisted format, migration, or user data depends on this Grain.

outcome: morize-core exposes one dependency-free CompatibilityClass enum for the five compatibility states already fixed by the repository policy, without adding serialization, parsing, version negotiation, deprecation timing, error taxonomy, persistence, or third-party dependencies.
rationale: P1 requires compatibility classes, and docs/API_COMPATIBILITY.md already freezes the exact five semantic classes. This Grain implements only that in-memory closed vocabulary so later public APIs and error contracts can reference one typed definition without deciding wire or persistence formats.
